title: Managed service providers face client trust challenges during ransomware recovery
summary: Managed service providers often struggle to maintain client trust following ransomware attacks due to communication gaps and billing inconsistencies, based on information published by Bleeping Computer.
why_it_matters: Ransomware operations combine disruption with extortion, making recovery speed and data-resilience core business risks.
recommendation: Verify offline backups, test restores, harden remote access, and review segmentation to limit lateral movement.

title: Amplifon Americas discloses data breach affecting sensitive customer information
summary: Tech Radar reports that Amplifon Americas has disclosed a significant cyberattack resulting in the unauthorized exposure of sensitive personal, insurance and healthcare-related information.
why_it_matters: Breaches and cybercrime activity signal where attackers are focusing and what data types are actively monetized.
recommendation: Validate incident-response readiness, monitor for exposed credentials, and reinforce MFA, phishing resistance, and data-loss controls.
